name: Studio One
description: An American radio–television anthology series, created in 1947 by Canadian director Fletcher Markle, who came to CBS from the CBC. Studio One, presented by Westinghouse, was one of the first of the anthology TV programs. The episodes were often abridged remakes of movies from years gone by and many future well-known television and movie actors appeared in the productions.

videos.overview: A teenage girl tries to increase the understanding between her football hero boyfriend and his widower father.

videos.title: The Man Who Caught the Ball at Coogan's Bluff
videos.overview: A shy, middle-aged baseball fan becomes a national celebrity after making a spectacular catch of a homerun ball.

videos.title: Blow Up at Cortland
videos.overview: The warden of Cortland Prison is up against the psychopathic leader of a group of rioters.

videos.title: The Strongbox
videos.overview: After the death of a Foreign Aid official, the reputation of the American Embassy in London comes into question. Was he a traitor or philanthropist?

videos.title: Miracle at Potter's Farm
videos.overview: Brucie and his elder sister, Jen, are two of five children who face separation and removal from the family farm after their father's death.

videos.title: Fair Play
videos.overview: A young army officer (Dewey Martin) waiting assignment is picked to defend a soldier in a court martial.  The soldier (James Gregory) is charged with a murder that was actually committed by the two MPs who arrested him.  The officer risks his career in search of material that can exonerate the soldier.

videos.title: Dino
videos.overview: Dino, who has just been released from reform school, is sullen and uncooperative with his family and his guidance counselors, but he knows that, if he returns to his life of crime, his adoring kid brother will be with him.

videos.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
videos.overview: Tom Ripley, a young underachiever, is sent to from New York to Italy to retrieve a rich and spoiled millionaire playboy, named Dickie Greenleaf. But when the errand fails, Ripley takes extreme measures.

videos.title: Johnny August
videos.overview: Johnny August is hesitant about helping track down a blackmailer in Mexico and winds up with a murder instead.

videos.title: A Public Figure
videos.overview: A successful TV actor becomes ensnared in an exposé in a scandal magazine.

videos.title: My Son Johnny
videos.overview: A magazine writer, married to his part-time editor, is vaguely discontented with his life. Then one night he learns that after many years of marriage, he is going to be a father. The news has an extraordinary effect on the lives of the couple.

videos.title: The Silent Gun
videos.overview: A famous gunfighter of the Wild West teaches his young ranch boy companion an important lesson in life. A team of men set out to sell a new Colt firearm and one is a sharpshooter, the other a salesman. One of the men is the famous Ringo Kid. When his identity is learned, there is trouble.

videos.title: Manhattan Duet
videos.overview: Two columnists cover the political scene and are practically identical twins. One is married, one is single and the wife of one wishes the other would get married and move to the suburbs. When the confirmed bachelor does announce plans for an impending marriage the two men decide to have adjoining penthouse apartments and the wives have other ideas.

videos.title: Circle of Guilt
videos.overview: A woman is found dead on a lonely beach outside a small town.

videos.title: Always Welcome
videos.overview: A widow takes in orphans and unwanted children with loving care. She finds her latest recruit is a little more troublesome than the others.

videos.title: A Favor for Sam
videos.overview: A quick-tempered cab driver picks up what appears to be two men and a drunk. On second look the drunk proves to be a corpse.

videos.title: Flower of Pride
videos.overview: A proud Florentine duchess's prayer to the Saint of the Impossible is answered in an unexpected manner. The Italian duchess has disowned her niece because the girl insists on living a gypsy-like life as a nightclub dancer. However, the arrival of a seemingly irreverent painter penetrates the stony facade of an archly unemotional duchess and humanizes her.

videos.title: The Laughter of Giants
videos.overview: A self-made man domineering in nature has a beautiful young wife who is interested in art. He introduces her to a young male artist to teach her to paint and learns a valuable lesson.

videos.title: The Tale of St. Emergency
videos.overview: An angel comes to Earth to help clean up a corrupt town.

videos.title: This Will Do Nicely
videos.overview: A man is dead. His wife calls in his best friend who is an amateur sleuth who calls it suicide but she calls it murder and says that he did it.

videos.title: The Arena
videos.overview: Arriving in Washington, a freshman senator gets an experienced advisor who warns him not to continue a heated feud with his state's senior salon, held over from his father. But later in a drunken jag, he blurts out secret evidence that can end the career of the older man.

videos.title: Regarding File Number 4356
videos.overview: A social worker is being forced to deprive a childless couple of a baby they have cared for and want to adopt.

videos.title: I Do
videos.overview: A young couple elope and try to hide in New York from their disappointed parents.

videos.title: The Drop of a Hat
videos.overview: The offices of Mode, a glossy women's magazine, is thrown into chaos when the owner suddenly shows up. The editor fears for her job--but who in the office might replace her?

videos.title: The Genie of Sutton Place
videos.overview: In New York City, a 13-year-old boy discovers the magic words that set a wish-granting genie free.

videos.title: The Star-Spangled Soldier
videos.overview: A not too sharp commandant of a military academy gets into some hilarious situations when he mistakes his father's invention for a war missile.

videos.title: Family Protection
videos.overview: A bank robber has an agreement with a suburban couple to use their home as his hideout in return for a share of the loot.

videos.title: The Power
videos.overview: A young professor must discover which of his colleagues possesses the diabolical ability to control the minds of others.

videos.title: Flight
videos.overview: A Mexican youth who lives on the California coast near Monterrey leaves his family to go on his first trip alone into town during fiesta time.

videos.title: Snap Your Fingers
videos.overview: A beautiful girl is a witch and her vain ex-suitor has been transformed into a peacock. She finally meets a nice young man from Boston.

videos.title: Mr. Arcularis
videos.overview: While a man lies unconscious on the operating table, he dreams that he has recovered and gone on a sea voyage to regain his health. However, death follows him in a recurrent dream in which he takes a journey through the heavens. The dream obsesses him, but Clarice, a pretty woman with whom he falls in love, forces him back to reality, at which point, he regains consciousness to find Clarice, his nurse, bending over him to say he is all right.

videos.title: The Luck of Luke McTigger
videos.overview: Luke McTrigger, proprietor of the Olympia saloon and hotel, has been thinking hard and has finally come up with a sure-fire plan to win the hand of the widow Baines. Now the widow is nothing to look at, and some folks say she's a bull-headed old battle-axe, but she has an estimated fortune of $900, and that's a lot of money in the Wyoming of 1880!

videos.title: Song for a Summer Night
videos.overview: A man who once played a hot trumpet in a band wants to break away from his successful law practice for a night and hear some good jazz. He and two other friends visit a nightclub and he manages to hit a "high" note of his own.

videos.title: Emmaline
videos.overview: A best selling novel leads everyone to wonder about who the author is.

videos.title: An Incident of Love
videos.overview: A young housewife befriends a withdrawn blind neighbor with beneficial results.

videos.title: The Ballad of Yermo Red
videos.overview: Yermo Red is a sadistic cop employed by a western railroad who delights in beating up hobos and finally kills one. The hobos want to avenge the dead man by killing Yermo. But one of them who hates violence prevails on them to try something else. He composes a song, "The Ballad of Yermo Red", which everybody up and down the railroad line begins singing.

videos.title: Something Ventured
videos.overview: A savage businessman is so hated by his employees that they band together and plan their own competing company.

videos.title: Giulio
videos.overview: In the Italian section of New York City, the talented Giulio Costello and Rose Pinato, spend the warm summer evenings on a park bench discussing Giulio's future. The young man is torn between love and the chance for a career in grand opera.

videos.title: A Day Before Battle
videos.overview: On the night before the Battle of Gettysburg, several Union soldiers capture a Southern spy and try to decide if it is morally permissible to shoot a prisoner.

videos.title: Cauliflower Heart
videos.overview: A small town businessman's son is killed and in order to fill the void he takes a tough youngster who needs a father under his wing.

videos.title: Dark Morning
videos.overview: A lumber baron is bent on revenge and intends to hang a man whom he believes responsible for his brother's death.

videos.title: A Special Announcement
videos.overview: An eccentric hobbyist inadvertently gets the original draft of the Gettysburg Address at an auction. He decides to burn the paper to bring a focus of attention on the ideals it contains but agrees to wait until after a TV debate.

videos.title: A Man's World
videos.overview: A cabin boy on an American yacht finds love in the French port of Cannes.

videos.title: The Open Door
videos.overview: When a man thumbs a ride and gets into an argument with the driver, he receives a 90-day jail sentence, but to his surprise, he is offered a job as counterman in a diner near the jail while serving his term, according to the ""open door"" policy of the prison.

videos.title: The Crimes of Peter Page
videos.overview: The museum curator's reputation comes under close scrutiny when several articles aren't what they appeared to be.

videos.title: American Primitive
videos.overview: A group of settlers on their way to Oregon stop for the night on a Western prairie. As the Indian tom-toms beat, tension in the small camp mounts, until finally the Indians themselves appear to demand justice.

videos.title: The Pilot
videos.overview: This episode depicts the story of Sister Mary Aquinas, who was the first nun ever to become a licensed aeroplane pilot.

videos.title: The Landlady's Daughter
videos.overview: When a smooth talking lawyer moves into the boarding house, tongues start wagging about the goings on with the landlady's daughter.

videos.title: Portrait of a Citizen
videos.overview: Lev Simon is in the U.S. illegally. As head of an immigrant family, he realizes his error when election time comes and he can't vote.

videos.title: Rachel
videos.overview: Andrew Jackson's wife Rachel makes a decision which impacts the entire country.

videos.title: Career
videos.overview: A 35-year-old ex-champion is goaded into the boxing ring by a sportscaster to fight the current champion.

videos.title: A Christmas Surprise
videos.overview: A special done like a "Person to Person" interview with a visit to a "typical" American home and family for a Christmas surprise.

videos.title: Goodbye Piccadilly
videos.overview: A secret agent is assigned to trail a brilliant scientist assuming that he is selling secrets to the enemy.

videos.title: Love at Fourth Sight
videos.overview: A young bachelor has a recurring dream about a girl named Pat who calls to him and then disappears. His mother is startled when he claims to have actually found the girl.

videos.title: The Dark Corner
videos.overview: Laura Morgan goes with her new husband to live in his mother's cheerless house. From her husband's mother, she learns a terrible secret about his past.

videos.title: The Five Dollar Bill
videos.overview: A sensitive young boy struggles to attain his own identity against the fumbling demands of his father and the solicitous affections of his mother.

videos.title: Dead of Noon
videos.overview: A western gunman obtains a law degree while serving time in jail. When released, he hopes to aid law and justice but learns that his days of gunslinging are not over yet.

videos.title: Tale of the Comet
videos.overview: Tim Tully has reached the top as a successful comic but is ruthless behind the scenes alienating many. Then as his ratings begin to slide he finds it difficult to get anyone, especially writers, to work for him.

videos.title: A Walk in the Forest
videos.overview: A young student with a promising career in science endangers his future in an immature college spree.

videos.title: The Hollywood Complex
videos.overview: When a young movie executive, with a distorted conception of the values and rewards of Hollywood, rejects his father as an embarrassing symbol of the past, the executive's two roommates and an exotic dancer give kindness to the bewildered old man, and in so doing, discover something important about themselves and their own need for love.

videos.title: The Defender (1)
videos.overview: A young criminal attorney and his firm-owning father defend a 19 year-old on trial for a murder that he swears he did not commit. Personal conflicts arise with the attorney and his father while the prosecution puts on a dramatic and convincing argument of guilt.

videos.title: The Defender (2)
videos.overview: A young criminal attorney and his firm-owning father defend a 19 year-old on trial for a murder that he swears he did not commit. Personal conflicts arise with the attorney and his father while the prosecution puts on a dramatic and convincing argument of guilt.

videos.title: A Child Is Waiting
videos.overview: Nurse Jean Horst, who works in a retarded children's home, is drawn to Reuben Widdicomb, a little boy whose mother hasn't come to visit him.

videos.title: Walk Down the Hill
videos.overview: During World War II, a Jewish American soldier questions his heritage when he is thrown in a German prison camp and learns that the Jewish GI's are to be put into a separate camp.

videos.title: A Member of the Family
videos.overview: Ellis is the wealthy, elder brother of the Davenport clan, who touches off a family conflict of jealousy and suspicion when he transfers his interest from one nephew to another.

videos.title: The Years in Between
videos.overview: A boy gets a date with the lovely girl who is visiting her relatives next door.

videos.title: The Playwright and the Stars
videos.overview: A Broadway producer signs a forgotten destitute one-time star in a pivotal role in his new play.

videos.title: The Rice Sprout Song
videos.overview: A Chinese peasant family's struggle for survival under Communist rule as obstacles and tragedy unfold.

videos.title: The Traveling Lady
videos.overview: Georgette and her little daughter arrive in a small Texas town to meet her husband, Henry, who has recently been released from prison. Georgette married Henry while he was a struggling singer, but soon after their marriage he was sent to prison for a 6-year term. Weak in character, Henry is now trying to make another start and is working as a gardener for one of the town's most trusting characters. But a new person enters Georgette's life, Slim Breedlove, a pleasant young man who offers to help her find her husband.

videos.title: Eight Feet to Midnight
videos.overview: A story about the outlawed Irish Republican Army

videos.title: The Out-of-Towners
videos.overview: A small-town postmistress, whose hopes are high when she makes her annual trip to the big city for a 3-day convention of Postal Employees, meets a middle-aged salesman and tries to encourage the acquaintanceship.

videos.title: Babe in the Woods
videos.overview: A tall handsome and extremely naive young man from the Midwest arrives in New York and is bewildered by the series of situations he stumbles into.

videos.title: The Man Who Wasn't Himself
videos.overview: Peter Hendon impersonated men in various professions as a surgeon, college professor and lawyer without any previous training in these fields.

videos.title: The Weston Strain
videos.overview: A young writer must decide if his first responsibility is to his family or his creative gift.

videos.title: The Furlough
videos.overview: A deranged soldier has escaped from the stockade vows to do away with his former platoon sergeant and trails him to the home of a dead buddy.

videos.title: The Mother Bit
videos.overview: A driven domineering career woman and her attempt to make a home in the country for her teen-age daughter. Kitty Sharpe is a popular television singer. Upon the death of her ex-husband, Kitty faces the problem of setting up housekeeping for the first time with her only child, Joy, a shy, attractive girl of seventeen.

videos.title: The Staring Match
videos.overview: Set in a small ranch town that is suffering from drought, townspeople gather to pray for rain in the schoolhouse. There is a knock at the door and a man dressed all in white greets everyone by name.  He says that his name is Mr. White and that he has been sent to help them find a well. Then another knock at the door reveals a man dressed all in black, who claims that his name is Mr. Black and that he is an angel of the Lord sent to help them also.  Not knowing which man to trust, the dilemma is resolved by a ""staring match"" between the two men. In the end, the angel is revealed and water is discovered.

videos.title: The Goodwill Ambassadors
videos.overview: An American agricultural expert and his wife are sent to a Latin-American country to help with its agricultural problems. The wife is distressed with the primitive native village where they are working and she misunderstands some of the villagers' customs and traditions.

videos.title: Death and Taxes
videos.overview: Henri and Marie own a bar in a small French town. They've been successfully cheating on their taxes for years, but that's about to end. A new tax collector's in town and the he's determined to make an example of slippery couple.

videos.title: A Matter of Guilt
videos.overview: A young wife is singled out as a hit-and-run driver through circumstantial evidence. Her husband desperately wages a battle to establish his wife's innocence.

videos.title: Love Me to Pieces
videos.overview: A publisher claims that he can make any song a hit. Drawing songs at random out of a file, he comes across a song by a teenage girl which she wrote when her romance had ended.

videos.title: In Love with a Stranger
videos.overview: Phyllis, a girl in her 20's, is just returning from her summer vacation, during which she has fallen in love with a struggling young musician. On the bus trip home Phyllis is telling her girlfriend of the difficulty she is going to have in breaking this news to her parents. Phyllis's parents and her aunt and uncle have made Phyllis the center of their lives. In their over-concern for her, they have naturally assumed she would marry George, the boy next door, whom she has known all her life. These four and George too, are on hand to welcome Phyllis home. Soon after their initial greeting, Phyllis tells them she intends to marry the young musician. They are shocked at the news and refuse to believe there can be anything to it.

videos.title: The Human Barrier
videos.overview: A test pilot suffers from shock, amnesia, and guilt after he crashes a new jet.

videos.title: My Mother and How She Undid Me
videos.overview: Baby Herman's view of adults as seen through his crib, looking in wide-eyed amazement into the faces of the people around him. He learns very early on how to wrap them around his finger with coos and howls.

videos.title: The Unmentionable Blues
videos.overview: A businessman feels life is all too soon passing him by. He seeks companionship from a young girl.

videos.title: Rudy
videos.overview: Rudy lives in a small New England town with his father. He begins to hang around a street gang called "The Eagles." These juvenile delinquents cause him problems with the law and his family. Rudy's loneliness and attempt to forget his crippled childhood turn his desperation into a new nightmare.

videos.title: Guitar
videos.overview: A classical guitarist is forced to take a job playing popular music after his son refuses to follow in his footsteps as a famous artist.

videos.title: The Dark Intruder
videos.overview: A music critic is mysteriously attacked in his Manhattan penthouse and thinks that a new composer whom he has panned is responsible.

videos.title: The Night America Trembled
videos.overview: Exploration of the panic caused by the radio broadcast of H.G. Wells ""War of the Worlds.""

videos.title: First Prize for Murder
videos.overview: At a Mystery Writers of America meeting, a government agent shows up, looking for a best selling author suspected of murder.

videos.title: Mutiny on the Shark (Part 1)
videos.overview: Commander Matt Donovan, the skipper of the newly commissioned atomic submarine "Shark" whose ruthless obsession for perfection leads him to expect his men to perform with the same cold precision as the incredible nuclear machine. Donovan has no patience with human frailty and he relentlessly drives his crew to be like himself. Donovan's two young officers Lt. Bill Meade and Lt. videos.title: The Morning After
videos.overview: A teenage student traps his Latin teacher into a compromise on grades by implying that she has made "advances" at him. Appalled and frightened by the implication that she is an immoral teacher at a private school for boys, she enlists the help of another teacher.

videos.title: Act of Mercy
videos.overview: A man lies in a coma for over a year as a result of a car accident. His brother, knowing the situation is hopeless, decides to end his existence.

videos.title: The Deaf Heart
videos.overview: A girl has lost her hearing as a result of an emotional disturbance. Her subconscious is probed by a team of psychologists who decide to try a daring experiment.

videos.title: The Bend in the Road
videos.overview: An elderly but energetic minister retires and lives with his overly attentive son and daughter-in-law.

videos.title: Twenty-Four Hours Til Dawn
videos.overview: An important political prisoner is awaiting execution by the men who have overthrown his country's government. The night before he is to face the firing squad, he is given a choice: if he will give up fighting for his cause, he will be set free.

videos.title: Please Report Any Odd Characters
videos.overview: An eccentric old man living at a boardinghouse begins concocting these stories and everyone becomes suspicious when young girls are found dead.

videos.title: Escape Route
videos.overview: A snobbish college professor finds implicated in the killing of a Latin American scholar. He finds himself hunted by a sinister ring of assassins.

videos.title: No Deadly Medicine (Part 1)
videos.overview: A conflict develops between Dr. Joseph Pearson and his young assistant, who attempts to introduce new methods in their pathology lab.

videos.title: No Deadly Medicine (Part 2)
videos.overview: Dr. Joseph Pearson and his young assistant clash over the circumstances of a premature birth and a cancer diagnosis.

videos.title: The Brotherhood of the Bell
videos.overview: A college fraternity will always help its members in later life - as long as they repay the fraternity by performing certain not-quite-legal tasks for other members.

videos.title: The Other Place
videos.overview: A Canadian engineer working in England rescues a rich elderly gentleman who changes his life.

videos.title: Trial by Slander
videos.overview: A schoolteacher gets in trouble. He is accused of having a romance in his educational dealings with his pupil. He gets trapped in a mess of circumstantial evidence.

videos.title: Balance of Terror
videos.overview: Harry Radcliff, a young British officer, sets out alone on a dangerous secret mission. He is to travel to Berlin and gain the confidence of Soviet agents by pretending to be traitor to England. But Radcliff finds himself in serious trouble when he misses an appointment with an important enemy contact. In desperation, he seeks aid from his friend Mike Fenby of the British Diplomatic Office in Berlin.

videos.title: The Laughing Willow
videos.overview: Belinda is one of the popular bachelor girls called on when guest lists are made up for Washington, D.C. parties. But beneath her gaiety, Belinda fears a life of loneliness, for she has frightened away suitors by her eagerness to marry. Then her friend Bunny introduces Belinda to handsome Jack Marshall.

videos.title: Presence of the Enemy
videos.overview: A religious widow fears that her beautiful and talented daughter may cause unrest and distrust in the small conservative Ohio community when she puts her love of art and career as a singer above the what the townspeople will think.

videos.title: Tide of Corruption
videos.overview: A young Senate investigator, Edward Roberts, begins digging into the racket empire of Mr. Antony. Then Mr. Antony investigates Roberts' background and discovers that at one time Roberts' mother accepted help from a crooked politician. In an attempt to deter the investigation, Antony approaches Roberts with blackmail in mind.

videos.title: The Lonely Stage
videos.overview: One of the greatest ladies of theater, Harriet Brand, decides to make a comeback but is hindered by her past indiscretions.

videos.title: The Fair-Haired Boy
videos.overview: A murder takes place in the public relations department of a motion picture company.

videos.title: A Dead Ringer
videos.overview: A businessman fed up with his invalid wife's tyrannical behavior finds a solution during a business trip. A man that looks exactly like him might be able to provide the alibi he needs to eliminate his wife.

videos.title: Tongues of Angels
videos.overview: A young man looking for work on a family farm indicates that he is not deaf and dumb but in fact suffers from a severe stuttering problem.

videos.title: The Award Winner
videos.overview: After years of hard work, Professor Theodore Koering, nuclear scientist has been awarded the Nobel Prize. Reporters sent to interview him are surprised at his apparent lack of interest in the honor accorded him, and baffled by his refusal to cooperate for pictures and stories. Their first lead develops when Kering forbids them to interview the widow of his former assistant.

videos.title: The Shadow of a Genius
videos.overview: After years of hard work, Professor Theodore Koering, nuclear scientist has been awarded the Nobel Prize. Reporters sent to interview him are surprised at his apparant lack of interest in the honor accorded him, and baffled by his refusal to cooperate for pictures and stories. Their first lead develops when Kering forbids them to interview the widow of his former assistant.

videos.title: Mrs. 'Arris Goes to Paris
videos.overview: Ada Harris, a London charwoman in the 1950's, sees a Dior dress and decides that she's going to own one. First, she scrimps and saves her money, but when she has enough, and takes a trip to Paris, she learns that buying an original couture creation is a little harder than simply plunking down cash. Along the way to her goal, she manages to befriend a count, unite young lovers, and dodge customs.

videos.title: The Desperate Age
videos.overview: It is puzzling to the family and office friends of Letty Greene that she has little interest in men and apparently no concern over the prospect that she may never marry. But Letty has been seeing a co-worker, Will Robbins, who is unhappily married. She tries not to face the future of this romance.

videos.title: The Edge of Truth
videos.overview: A policeman apprehends the reckless driver of a vehicle when a little girl almost gets hit and finds himself being bribed by the driver, a wealthy playboy.

videos.title: The McTaggert Succession
videos.overview: When their elder spinster sister Rosie becomes bedridden, the three McTaggart brothers, all bachelors, hire their 19-year-old niece Kathleen to help out with the household chores. All goes well until she falls in love and, much to the alarm of her uncles, contemplates marriage.

videos.title: Kurishiki Incident
videos.overview: A GI kills a boy that he thought was stealing government property and is court martialed and acquitted of the crime. The boy's sister and uncle confront him and he seeks to make amends.

videos.title: A Funny-Looking Kid
videos.overview: In an attempt to help his shy son Frank to become more popular at school, Harry Breen suggest to Frank that he do some writing. The plot backfires when the boy embarks on a crusade to remedy juvenile delinquency. His article, naming parents as the real delinquents, appears in the local newspaper and overnight Frank becomes a national celebrity.

videos.title: The Enemy Within
videos.overview: An Air Force crew prepares for a rugged 2-week survival course and everyone is worried.

videos.title: Ticket to Tahiti
videos.overview: A widower's dreams of escaping his job and family with a trip to the South Seas fall through when his spoiled irresponsible son asks him for a large sum of money.

videos.title: The Strong Man
videos.overview: Ben Royce prides himself on being a self-made man who has become the most powerful cattle baron in the West. He rules his family and his ranch with an iron hand, and there are many clashes between him and his foreman Jace Farrow. After a particularly bitter quarrel, Jace tells Royce that he is quitting to go into the cattle business on his own. Believing that Jace will fail on his own, Royce makes no attempt to stop him. As Jace prepares to leave, he asks Marcy Royce, Ben's daughter to go with him.

videos.title: The Left-Handed Welcome
videos.overview: Buck Slater, youthful singing sensation, makes a return visit to his small home town in he south, accompanied by a woman magazine writer named Shirley. Shirley wants to write the real Story of Buck as he was before he left for the big-time. Buck has a score to settle with the town and when a youngster is accused of a series of thefts, Buck offers to take the boy under his wing.

videos.title: The Man Who Asked for a Funeral
videos.overview: Leo is a hard-working young man who owns and operates a wholesale produce firm, and is very much in love with his pretty young wife Annabelle. He doesn't know that Annabelle has been seeing a clerk who works for him. The clerk, Frankie, plans to murder Leo and implicate Annabelle.

videos.title: The Undiscovered
videos.overview: A medical researcher feels that he has made an important discovery.

videos.title: Man Under Glass
videos.overview: Tension inside the television director's control booth mounts to a breaking point when the television drama spills over into life and death reality.

videos.title: A Delicate Affair
videos.overview: An insurance company tries to marry off a girl within a week. Failure means the girl gets one million dollars.

videos.title: The Last Summer
videos.overview: A country boy is taken in by a scheming rich girl who is spending her vacation in the country.

videos.title: Tag-Along
videos.overview: Little Juan and his parents have moved to a new town to escape the prejudice they encountered as Mexicans. But things go badly in the new town too, reaching a climax when Juan and two teenage friends of his disappear while visiting a canyon outside town.

videos.title: Birthday Present
videos.overview: A young British businessman, attempting to smuggle a watch he purchased as a gift for his wife into the country, is arrested by customs officials and sent to prison.

videos.title: Bellingham
videos.overview: You wouldn't suspect that Bellingham is anything but what he appears to be, a conscientious and sensitive master in an English boys' school. Actually he also leads another life entirely. He hates evil political leaders, and belongs to a group determined to eliminate them by assassination.

videos.title: The Lady Died at Midnight
videos.overview: A convicted murderer vows that he will break out of prison and revenge himself on the people responsible for his capture. When he does escape, the police post a cordon around the home of his former girlfriend, who has married. But, despite their precautions, the girl is killed. A reporter learns that the dead girl's husband and   the police chief have also been threatened.

videos.title: No Place to Run
videos.overview: The son of a prominent businessman is arrested for stealing a car. His father goes to great lengths to keep the matter private and out of the headlines. A reporter snaps their photo as they're leaving the courthouse, resulting in unwanted publicity. This is when the father starts getting blackmail threats.

videos.title: Image of Fear
videos.overview: After 20 years in exile in the United States, a royal family has hope that the monarchy will be able to return to power. But intrigue arises as someone tries to kill the queen. The prime suspect is her son, Prince Anthony, who was told that he must give up his wife if he returns to the throne.
